units.source_text: 桌子上有一盏油灯，灯光昏暗。

en.t: There was an oil lamp on the table, its light dim and murky.

units.source_text: 这灯光不仅没有照亮屋子，而且给屋子里更营造了一种阴郁的氛围。

en.t: This light not only failed to brighten the room, but made the room feel even more gloomy.

units.source_text: 屋子里的壁纸已经有剥落的迹象了，布满灰尘的帐子从屋角的藤床上垂了下来，毛毯的一角也耷拉下来。

en.t: The wallpaper in the room already showed signs of peeling; a dust-covered curtain hung down from the wicker bed in the corner, and one corner of the blanket drooped as well.

units.source_text: 桌子对面也是一把同样简陋老旧的椅子，像是被忘记一样的闲置在一旁。

en.t: Opposite the table was another chair, just as plain and old, left unused to one side as if it had been forgotten.

units.source_text: 除了这些东西，屋里在没有其他摆设了。

en.t: Apart from these things, there were no other furnishings in the room.
